name: image-generation
description: Generate an image from a prompt (Gemini image model over REST, standard library only) or edit one, saved under <workspace>/results/media/ and attached to the reply; generate a video with Veo when the google-genai SDK is installed. The key is any Gemini key the credential resolver finds (managed voice key included).
core_description: Generate an image from a text description (a logo, a hero image, a mascot, a mockup) or edit an existing image, and send it back as a file; generate a short video from a prompt or an image. Delegate through work; the result arrives as an attachment.
